title: Scorched Guns 2: AsYasya's WW1 Weaponry
description: A Scorched Guns 2 addon bringing historic weaponry from the First World War
body:
![The weaponry:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/000e8e5c9fea83b68e122fbb28a7aa1eff964a1d.png)
This mod adds 15 new weapons to the iron tier:

- Mosin-Nagant
- Mosin Sawn-off
- Obrez Pistol
- Fedorov Rifle
- Fedorov Avtomat
- Mauser C96
- Luger P08
- Nambu Pistol
- Browning Pistol
- Nagant
- Sawn-off Shotgun
- Winchester M1897
- Combat Winchester M1897
- Madsen Machine Gun
- Mosin Grenade Launcher
